## EMCargo v1.30.1

This cleanup release corrects release metadata and documentation following v1.30.0.

### Fixed

- Keeps `package-lock.json` aligned with the canonical EMCargo version before tagging.
- Restores the complete release history to one continuous `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Corrects the dangerous-goods coverage assessment: missing IATA Q input is explicitly reported since v1.30.0; the remaining limitation is that n and M must be supplied manually because IATA quantity tables are not included.

### Changed

- Release preparation now normalises derived metadata before creating the tag.
- LQ/EQ application is documented as the next data-supported dangerous-goods priority.
